Exterior Painting Prices Across Sugar Land, Missouri City, Richmond, Katy, Fulshear, Rosenberg & West Houston

Most homeowners invest between $2,500 and $16,000+ depending on the size of the home, surface condition, and level of preparation required.

Exterior painting in Texas is not just about appearance — it’s about protecting your home from sun, humidity, and long-term wear.

Start My Free Painting Estimate

Quick Exterior Painting Price Breakdown

Most projects fall into these ranges:

Small Homes / Partial Exteriors
$2,500 – $5,000
Medium Homes
$5,000 – $10,000
Large Homes / Full Repaints
$10,000 – $16,000+

These ranges vary based on prep work, repairs, access, and surface type.

Exterior Painting Rates

Our pricing reflects the actual work required — especially prep.

  • Walls (stucco/siding): $2.00 – $2.50 per sq ft

  • Trim: $1.75 – $2.50 per linear ft

  • Fascia & soffits: $18 – $30 per linear ft

  • Doors: $120 – $180 each

  • Garage doors (metal/wood): $250 – $600 each

Prep & Repair (When Needed)

  • Pressure washing

  • Scraping and sanding

  • Caulking and sealing

  • Wood repair or replacement

  • Priming exposed or damaged areas

Exterior prep is often the biggest factor in long-term performance.

Why Exterior Painting Costs Vary So Much

If you’ve ever received two very different exterior painting quotes, this is why.

Exterior pricing is heavily influenced by preparation and environmental exposure — not just square footage.

  • Surface condition: peeling paint, cracks, or damage

  • Type of material: stucco, wood, brick, or siding

  • Amount of prep required: scraping, sanding, caulking

  • Sun exposure: west-facing homes fade faster

  • Moisture and humidity: impacts adhesion and longevity

  • Height and access: two-story homes require more time and equipment

  • Pressure washing to clean surfaces

  • Protection of landscaping and surrounding areas

  • Primer where needed

  • Professional paint application

  • Cleanup and final walkthrough

  • Warranty options

No shortcuts. No skipped steps.

Learn More About Our Exterior Prep Process

Surface-Specific Considerations

Different surfaces require different approaches:

Stucco

  • Requires sealing and proper coating

  • Can hold moisture if not treated correctly

Wood

  • Needs careful prep and protection

  • More prone to peeling and damage

Brick

  • Requires breathable coatings

  • Often needs specialized prep

What Impacts Whether You’re at the Low or High End

Lower End of the Range

Higher End of the Range

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should you repaint a home exterior?

Most homes need repainting every 5–10 years, depending on exposure and materials.

What exterior paint lasts the longest in Texas?

High-quality products like premium acrylic systems designed for UV and humidity perform best.

Do you pressure wash before painting?

Yes. Proper cleaning is essential for adhesion and longevity.

Can you paint over peeling paint?

No. Peeling areas must be scraped and prepped before painting.
